result.title: RELAY: Learning Compatible Representations One Encoder at a Time
result.summary: Old and new document embeddings coexist during incremental gallery re-encoding. RELAY trains a new query encoder with a learned projection against the original gallery, then freezes both to train the new document encoder. The same query vector scores both document versions throughout a single re-encoding pass. After backfill, optional query refinement drops the projection and reuses the stored document vectors. Across three text-to-image retrieval upgrades on COCO and Flickr30K, RELAY improves Recall@1 on untouched galleries by 8.66-10.23 percentage points over the original systems. For direct re-encoding, RELAY ranks first in both Qwen-to-Qwen upgrades and second in CLIP-to-Qwen by area under the Recall@1 curve, under both native scoring and matched calibration. With embeddings held fixed, calibrating scores separately for each document version can reduce drops in Recall@1 during backfill and change which method achieves the highest backfill AUC. After query refinement, final Recall@1 is within 0.97 percentage points of conventional joint training in all three upgrades.

AI.brief_summary: RELAY 研究增量替换编码器时新旧文档嵌入共存的问题：先冻结原图库、训练带可学习投影的新查询编码器，再冻结二者训练新文档编码器，使同一查询向量在一次回填中同时对齐两版文档；回填后可选地去掉投影做查询微调。在 COCO、Flickr30K 的三次 text-to-image 检索升级中报告了未被回填库上的 Recall@1 提升与回填曲线 AUC 对比。
AI.relevance_reason: 其分阶段训练加投影以维持新旧表示空间可比、并支持嵌入缓存复用的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中跨层或跨版本 latent 状态比较与缓存复用的可比性问题；但任务本身是检索嵌入兼容而非多模态推理状态生成，与主线的距离较远。
